categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Longtech Smart Control Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of smart controllers and smart products. Its products serve industries including smart home appliances, energy storage, automotive electronics, and new consumer electronics. The company operates mainly through OEM and ODM business models, providing both core components and integrated smart products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as microcontroller units (MCU), digital signal processors (DSP), embedded software, and integrates automatic control, sensing, microelectronics, communication, power electronics, and electromagnetic compatibility technologies. Production employs flexible, lean manufacturing with U-shaped assembly lines, combining automation and manual processes to support multi-variety, small-batch, and multi-batch customized production. R&D focuses on platform modularization, advanced control algorithms, and integration of Bluetooth, WiFi, and touch control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known international brands in smart home appliances, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and energy storage sectors. The company has strategic partnerships with clients such as GLP, Simplehuman, Breville, Conair, and Decent Motor. Its products are used in smart home devices, automotive electronic controls, health care, and new consumer electronics, with a focus on mid-to-high-end market segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 70% of revenue. It is expanding its international presence with subsidiaries and production facilities in Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, and other Southeast Asian markets. The Thailand production base is under construction to support overseas market demand and global supply chain diversification.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longtech operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain as a manufacturer and designer of smart controllers and smart products. It serves as a core component supplier to downstream brand owners and OEM/ODM partners, providing both design and manufacturing services. The company also extends into smart product development, collaborating closely with end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strengthening R&D capabilities with increased investment, focusing on emerging technologies such as AI applications in smart controllers, platform-based product development, and modular design. It pursues innovation in control algorithms, communication technologies, and energy management solutions. Strategic priorities include expanding global footprint, deepening cooperation with key customers, and enhancing product quality, cost control, and delivery efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales under OEM and ODM models. The company produces smart controllers and smart products either based on customer designs (OEM) or its own designs (ODM), selling directly to brand owners or their contract manufacturers. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, supported by long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longtech is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the smart controller manufacturing industry, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It competes in the mid-to-high-end market segment with advanced technology, strong R&D, and quality assurance capabilities. The company holds a competitive edge through its diversified product portfolio, rapid response, and established relationships with major international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, representing a 54.7% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 154 million, up 42.12%. The company’s net asset value reached RMB 1.34 billion, with steady growth in revenue, profit, and cash flow. R&D investment increased by 28.89% to RMB 68.33 million, accounting for 4.29% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longtech differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, advanced control technologies, and high-quality manufacturing processes. It offers integrated smart control solutions with rapid development cycles and flexible production to meet diverse customer needs. The company emphasizes product reliability, cost competitiveness, and fast delivery, supported by comprehensive quality management systems and close collaboration with leading global brands, enhancing customer stickiness and market reputation.
